name: Sibat
source: Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 0, Ultimate Combat pg. 134, Ultimate Equipment pg. 18
body:
Source Ranged Tactics Toolbox pg. 0, Ultimate Combat pg. 134, Ultimate Equipment pg. 18
Statistics
Cost 2 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x3; Range 10 ft.; Type P or S; Special grapple
Category One-Handed; Proficiency Martial
Weapon Groups Spears; Thrown
Description
This weapon is similar to a shortspear with a flexible rattan or bamboo shaft and an elaborately barbed head. The barbs can snag flesh, clothing, or armor to ensnare an enemy.
